subject: Transition guide source code now on GitHub

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Transition guide source code now on GitHub
parts:
Greetings:

The source code for the ggplot2 transition guide to 0.9.0 has been put
up on GitHub. My username there is djmurphy420 and the repository name
is ggplot2-transition-guide. It contains a README.txt file plus the
current state of the document, named ggplot2-0.9.0.Rnw. Feel free to
clone it and make changes in separate branches of the repo. If you
want to contribute something but don't use GitHub, send it to me
privately at djmuseR at gmail dot com and I'll try to incorporate the
changes myself on your behalf.

As noted in the README file, I've used the recently released knitr
package to produce this document. One thing I failed to mention is
that no spaces are allowed in the code chunk headers. This is seen in
the examples, but it needs to be stated up front to avoid confusion.

Thanks in advance to those who wish to contribute!

Dennis
